primaryGate.description: Mean task success for agent-ready must not fall more than 5 percentage points below raw.

benefitGate.description: Median unnecessary file reads for agent-ready must be at least 15% lower than raw, after primary and safety gates pass.

outcomes.helps: Primary and safety gates pass and benefit gate passes.
outcomes.noDemonstratedBenefit: Primary and safety gates pass but benefit gate fails.
outcomes.mixed: Primary gate passes but any safety gate fails.
